shorts_rules: State the central topic or resolve the hook's premise within the first 5 seconds to prevent immediate early drop-off.
Make abstract numbers or scales feelable by comparing them to everyday objects like ballpoint pens, cars, or food.
Use a contradiction, hidden mystery, or counter-intuitive fact as the opening line to drive strong initial curiosity.
Structure scripts with clear cause-and-effect progression: introduce a problem, show the failure, and reveal the physical or mechanical solution.
Keep our narration pace between 2.4 and 2.8 words per second to ensure clear delivery without feeling rushed.
Avoid open-ended, overly philosophical questions near the end which kill engagement; use concrete payoffs instead.
Always conclude the video by immediately transitioning into our mandatory brand sign-off without dragging out the ending.
Ensure the core subject or device name is explicitly stated early rather than relying purely on vague pronoun hooks.
visual_sound_notes: Use high-end 3D animated cutaways or continuous zoom visuals to match complex technical and microscopic explanations.
Maintain an average cut rate of 2.0 to 2.8 cuts per 10 seconds to keep visual pacing brisk without causing motion fatigue.
Incorporate bold, dynamic center captions with highlighted keywords and alternating color badges for key scientific terms.
Layer low atmospheric ambient music with sharp mechanical or spatial Foley effects under a clean, close-mic voice-over.
summary_roman_urdu: Is mahine ke viral shorts se yeh pata chalta hai ke viewers ko complex science aur tech topics mein ajeeb o ghareeb contradictions aur real-world comparisons bohot pasand aate hain. Hamare apne pichle videos mein log isliye chhod gaye kyunke shuruat mein topic clear hone ke bajaye confuse ho gaye aur aakhir mein sawal bohat philosophical tha. Hamein apni script ki pehli 5 seconds mein subject bilkul clear karna hoga aur ajeeb analogies use karni hongi taake log hook ho jayein. Visuals mein 3D cutaways aur fast pacing rakhni hai aur aakhir mein apna fixed sentence bina kisi lambi philosophy ke bol kar video khatam karni hai.
